title: Working on new Roblox game [🔥 searching for testers 🔥]
author: Spirited-Objective14
selftext:
Hey all 👋

For past month I've been working on this game idea where you fly around, train your flying skills, getting faster, doing missions and challenges, upgrading wings, auras, trails etc etc. 

For now play testing with brother and his son, but would love if some of you (best if real Roblox players) would also join us.

It's still early version, I try to fix, update or add smth each day.  
  
Using:  

* Fable 5.2 (for coding more complex mechanics) 
* Opus 5.5 (for coding) 
* Asta 6 (for coding and creating images used in the game) 
* Blender (for some 3d models) 
* Sonilo (for sounds effects)

Will be waiting your Roblox handles for those who would like to check this out.
